title: Our Gallery (Demo)
dedication: Every picture here is made up, so you can look without worrying about anyone's privacy.

notes.text: This gallery is a floor plan of rectangles and doorways, filled in room by room. Every room has its own colour.
The red carpet runs from the front door to the garden. The garden has a skylight that follows the real time of day.
Behind the garden there is a planetarium: lie back on a lounger and the dome fills with stars. Press E at the projector to change the sky.
The cinema past the garden shows a slideshow while it waits for a film. The popcorn stand pops by itself.
You are Teddy, the gallery dog. Walk up to the sculpture, sit by the benches, or bark at the paintings.
None of the pictures are real photos. They were drawn by a short script, so the walls are never empty.

surprise.title: One last thing...
surprise.text: You found every little heart in the gallery.
surprise.question: Did you enjoy the walk?

paragraphs: You found every note, which means you walked the whole way down the red carpet to get here.
This is a demo of a private gallery that was built as a gift. The real one has real photographs; this one has drawings, so anyone can wander through it.

monthiversary.title: Happy monthiversary
monthiversary.text: Another month has gone by. Here is to the next one.
monthiversary.yearText: Another year. Thank you for visiting.
